Boutique hotel in the heart of Chelsea
An intimate, very private boutique hotel situated close to Sloane Square, in the heart of Chelsea, comprising 19 individually themed bedrooms and suites each furnished with an extraordinary variety of valuable antique furniture and art.
A fine treasure hidden away in a quiet residential corner of Chelsea, close to Sloane Square, San Domenico House is a boutique townhouse hotel brimming with an elegant mix of sumptuous interiors, eclectic antiques and Latin personality. Recently extended and redesigned, the hotel offers 19 delightful luxury rooms and suites, and a bespoke room service menu to complement the outstanding selection of fine and Michelin-starred restaurants within easy strolling distance.

pages.title: Rooms - San Domenico House
pages.text:
Rooms - San Domenico House
Vai al contenuto
ROOMS & SUITES
All 19 rooms and suites boast individually themed and exceptionally designed interiors
All 19 rooms and suites boast individually themed and exceptionally designed interiors, with paneled walls and ragged paintwork complemented by exquisite fabrics and eclectic antiques collected by the owners during their travels.
Some feature rare original pictures from 18th century Italian and English Art Schools; several have a small balcony/terrace overlooking Chelsea.
CLASSIC DOUBLE
Since refurbishment, San Domenico House has a new Classic Double room available, ideal for a short stop over or a business trip
Discover more
DELUXE DOUBLE
Deluxe Double rooms are all individually designed with sumptuous antiques dating back to 19 th century Italian, English as well as French Art Schools.
Discover more
DELUXE DOUBLE with balcony
Deluxe Double rooms are all individually designed with sumptuous antiques dating back to 19 th century Italian, English as well as French Art Schools.
Discover more
GALLERY SUITE
Gallery suites are split level luxury rooms, individually themed and designed with rich warm fabrics from famous designers. The entrance is on the upper level where a sitting area is located with an antique table and comfy chairs.
Discover more
JUNIOR SUITE
Junior Suites are large bedrooms with high ceilings with a king size bed that can be split on request. They feature ragged paint and paneled walls also furnished with exquisite antique furniture. The large sitting area with sofas, desks, and chairs, is the ideal spot to relax or work remotely.
Discover more
JUNIOR SUITE WITH BALCONY

FAQs
What is the nearest tube station?
Sloane Square Station [District and Circle line (green and yellow line)]
South Kensington [District, Circle and Piccadilly line (green, yellow and blue line)] *blue line has a direct connection with Heathrow Airport (all terminals)
Victoria Station [Victoria line (light blue) + Victoria Coach Station]
Airports with public transports
London has 4 main airports: Heathrow Airport (T.1-2-3-4-5) Piccadilly line in 1 hour from Knightsbridge (Blue) or Train in 20 min from Paddington Station
Gatwick Airport (T. South or North) trains in 45 minutes from and to Victoria Station (Victoria line light blue)
London City Airport DLR line (2 tube changes from SDH in 50 minutes)
Stansted Airport Bus from and to Victoria Coach Station in 1 hour and 40 minutes or trains from and to Liverpool Street Station (Circle line, 20 minutes from SDH) in 47 minutes

Please note that times route change from night time to day time. Heathrow Airport: from 40 to 50 min

wikipedia.title: San Domenico House
wikipedia.extract: San Domenico House is a boutique hotel located at 29-32 Draycott Place, in Chelsea, London. The hotel has 19 rooms and is part of the San Domenico Hotels group, owned by Aldo Melpignano, and it is a sister hotel to the Borgo Egnazia. It was previously known as the Sloane Hotel until 2006, when it was located at number 29 Draycott Place.
